subject: Tideview Bank — post-demo security recap & evidence request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Carter <ethan.carter@tideviewbank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@tideviewbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Tideview — post-demo security recap & evidence request

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and concrete asks so we can align on a security acceptance path. I tried to keep this focused on the items your InfoSec team flagged.

Key pain points we heard
- Audit logs: need immutable, tamper-evident logs with searchability for 7 years for a subset of events.
- Retention: multi-tier retention windows (30d hot, 365d cold, >365d archival) and proof of purge for tenants.
- Data residency & DPA: need fields-level controls and clear contractual language around backups.
- Third-party testing: SOC 2 Type II evidence and recent pentest report for vendor risk.

What we propose (high-level)
- Provide our SOC 2 Type II summary and recent penetration test summary.
- Share an example audit-log extract spec and retention export format for your engineers to validate.
- Draft DPA clauses that map to your contractual requirements for backups/retention.

Asks / action items for Tideview
1) Please send the SOC/infosec contact for formal evidence intake (we'll run through a short DDQ).
2) Attach current retention/export spreadsheet (if available) and a sample event list you must capture.
3) Confirm any legal/regulatory retention windows beyond the 7-year ask.

Attachments: redwood-security-pack.pdf (brief SOC2 + retention overview, runtime audit-log examples)

Next steps
- I can have a tailored evidence checklist and a draft DPA by early next week once we get the contacts and the retention sheet.
- If it helps, we can schedule a short technical sync between your platform engineer and Marcus to go over log formats.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-tideview-followup

From: Ethan Carter <ethan.carter@tideviewbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@tideviewbank.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tideview — post-demo security recap & evidence request

Thanks, Irene — useful summary. A couple quick answers and I've attached a current retention spreadsheet that our ops team uses.

Quick answers
- SOC contact: Priya Singh (cc'ed) will own the formal evidence intake.
- Retention: the spreadsheet (attached) shows our nominal retention: 90d hot, 730d cold, some archived records beyond 7 years only for regulatory transactions (marked in the sheet).
- Pen test: we run an annual external pentest; the latest executive summary is under review with legal but I can share a redacted summary once cleared.

Open questions for you
- Can Redwood provide a sample audit-log export with event-level timestamps and user-id hashing/pseudonymization options? We need to validate the granularity.
- For DPA, we want explicit language on backup retention and deletion confirmation for deleted tenants.

Attachments:
- tideview-current-retention.xlsx
- security-contact.vcf

I'll coordinate with Priya to route the formal DDQ and a contact for legal when appropriate. Happy to set the technical sync — Marcus, can you suggest 2 x 30-min slots next week?

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Carter | Head of Platform Security, Tideview Bank

Subject: Re: Tideview — post-demo security recap & evidence request

Looping in Monica for legal/DPA support and adding some technical detail we should confirm with Tideview before we prepare the checklist: 

Technical clarifications we need
- Exact event list: We can support admin/login/role-change/data-export/access-control events out-of-the-box. Need to know any custom event types.
- Immutability: Our audit log storage uses write-once S3 + signed event digests for tamper evidence; we need to confirm your verification process (hashing algorithm) if you do independent checks.
- Exports: We can produce CSV/JSONL exports and a daily compressed archive. Confirm whether you need per-tenant key-wrapping on archives (we support customer-managed keys).

Proposed artifact list from Redwood
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted) — if legal allows
- Example audit-log export (JSONL) & schema doc (we'll produce a one-page schema)
- Draft DPA clauses around backup retention and deletion confirmations

I'll take point on the example export and schema. Monica, can you draft the DPA language in parallel?

Marcus
VP, Applied ML & Serving Runtime
